name: dsh-theme-blackhole
description: Black hole theme plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: WebGL Schwarzschild black hole background with deep-space glass panels, all shipped inside the client bundle (no server routes, no index.html injection). Enabled while installed (no toggle) — disable or remove the plugin to restore the default theme. Install into a web profile: dsh plugin --profile web add <path-to-this-package>
